reviews.title: Did not work
reviews.text: I downloaded the app. Would not open or work at all.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Not creative or the level of adult emojis I was hoping for, and way overpriced for what it was.

reviews.title: Scam?
reviews.text: I paid for the full version.  Still getting ads and a message telling me that I can pay to unlock all 3000 emoticons.  Isn’t that what I’ve already paid for, but have not yet received?

reviews.title: Won’t open
reviews.text: Nothing but a page of the icon

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and it will not work. I just get a logo and then it goes away.

reviews.title: Paid for nothing..
reviews.text: App doesn’t work. I click it and it closes on its own.

reviews.title: Pop up “rate this app” continuously
reviews.text: Why do I constantly need to rate this app after I’ve paid for it??? Do you constantly need reassurance to fuel your ego? If anyone is looking to buy this app, save your money and avoid all apps by this developer as the constant barrage of “rate this app” becomes a pop-up annoyance.

app.name: Emoticons Keyboard Pro - Adult Emoji for Texting
